purpose: Define the minimum task and causal-evidence conditions before any formal multi-seed experiment is launched.
platform: Existing three-UAV 3DOF interception plant; the flight dynamics, legal local observations and primitive flight actions remain the starting point.
candidate_problem: Timed targeting-service handoff under a limited relay opportunity: a scout obtains a track, while the relay must choose between retaining the current public service route for early authorization and relocating to a later public service route for a post-stage refresh. Both outcomes require legal relay-mediated target delivery.
candidate_method: Handoff-value-conditioned local relation policy. The actor receives only legal local observations, delivered message provenance/age and visible communication state; a declared relation-value head scores legal handoff relations and conditions the policy without restoring hidden target state.
fixed_controls: same 3DOF plant and primitive action interface
same reward, horizon, PPO objective and training budget within each comparison
same handoff action availability for all compared methods
same training and endpoint seed tapes after formal freeze

required_pretraining_gates.G0_decision_switch: A scripted legal controller must demonstrate at least two reachable contexts in which forward-now versus reposition-for-later reverses the preferred action and changes terminal mission outcome.
required_pretraining_gates.G1_information_boundary: Changing hidden target state while holding every legal actor input fixed must not change actor logits; all handoff labels must be computable from legal state only.
required_pretraining_gates.G2_non_saturation: A capacity-matched plain MAPPO pilot must be learnable but non-saturated on the main band; the target development range is 0.30-0.80 success, not a publication threshold.
required_pretraining_gates.G3_mechanism_signal: A small paired pilot must show that the candidate differs from the capacity-matched MLP in handoff allocation and in at least one prespecified terminal or reliability endpoint.
required_pretraining_gates.G4_ablation_identifiability: The same candidate network with shuffled legal handoff-relation labels must be executable and preserve parameter count, observations, actions, reward and budget.

formal_experiment_entry_rule: Formal training is permitted only if G0-G4 pass. A failed gate triggers a localized task/interface repair and a rerun of that gate, not retrospective relabelling of development output as paper evidence.
prohibited_claims_before_formal_entry: the task establishes an OOD result
the development pilots are publication evidence

current_evidence.G0_interpretation: Development-only zero-training audit: current authorization favours retaining the current relay route (6/6 versus 0/6); post-stage refresh favours relocation to the future public route (6/6 versus 0/6). The terminal is targeting-service completion; attack-window state is logged independently rather than used to confound G0.
current_evidence.credit_alignment_interpretation: Read-only legal-controller audit: increment-based staged-service reward ranks the successful controller above the failed controller in both contexts. It verifies objective alignment, not learned performance.
current_evidence.interpretation: G0 and G1 have passed for the staged-handoff task. Short development pilots did not establish G2. The running 98,304-step plain-MAPPO long pilot is development-only and requires context-stratified endpoint evaluation before any candidate-method work.
